This qualified them for the [[2018 LoL KeSPA Cup|2018 KeSPA Cup]], where they upset LCK team [[Hanwha Life Esports]] in the elimination round, before falling to [[DAMWON Gaming]] in the qualification round. After the KeSPA Cup ended, Gumayusi renamed to Catan and joined [[SK Telecom T1]] as a trainee. ===2020 Season=== After having been a trainee and substitute on [[T1]] for most of 2019 and 2020, Gumayusi made his unexpected professional debut for T1 in the [[LCK/2020 Season/Regional Finals|2020 Regional Finals]]. T1 was seeded into the second round due to their regular season performance, where they defeated [[Afreeca Freecs]] 3-1 before falling to [[Gen.G]] 3-0 in the final round, missing out on Worlds. == Trivia == * Achieved the first-ever three-peat in Worlds championship alongside his teammates [[Oner]], [[Faker]], and [[Keria]]. * Is the younger brother of one of the greatest StarCraft II players of all time, [https://liquipedia.net/starcraft2/INnoVation INnoVation]. * Started playing LoL in Season 2, he would watch his third brother play and take his turn playing top lane with champions like [[Darius]], [[Gnar]] and [[Cho'Gath]].[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ct36mme8eHQ&t=300s 구마유시가 걸어온 길 | CARVED:PROVE] ''youtube.com'' ** He eventually plays {{ci|cho'gath}} in a game in [[LCK/2023 Season/Spring Season|LCK Spring 2023]]. * He is the sixth of seven siblings. * He has a Pomeranian named Doongi. * His role model in League of Legends is [[Uzi (Jian Zi-Hao)|Uzi]]. * Reached Rank 1 on KR in 2021. * Is the distant nephew of [[Faker]], making him the 40th generation descendant from the Gyeongju Lee clan.[https://twitter.com/skt_save/status/1490769501121826816?s=20&t=i5PA7CvAfCWE_ajFzNzXtw Faker and Gumayusi revelation] ''twitter.com'' [https://rvgamepc.com/gumayusi-was-shocked-when-he-discovered-that-the-demon-king-was-his-cousin/ Gumayusi was shocked when he discovered that the Demon King was… his cousin] ''rvgamepc.com'' * With 219 kills in [[LCK 2022 Spring]], he is the player with the most kills in one LCK's split, beating the previous record of 209 kills set by [[Ruler]] in [[LCK 2020 Summer]].[https://gamingnews.cyou/lol-gumayusi-and-keria-break-records-in-the-lck/ LoL: Gumayusi and Keria break records in the LCK] ''gamingnews.cyou'' ** This record would be surpassed by [[Aiming]] and [[Peyz]] in [[LCK/2023 Season/Summer Season|LCK 2023 Summer]] * Reached 1000 LCK kills on August 2nd, 2023 ** Was the 25th player to reach 1000 kills in the LCK, after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Smeb]], [[Ambition]], [[Sangyoon]], [[Deft]], [[Teddy]], [[Ruler]], [[Bdd]], [[Ghost (Jang Yong-jun)|Ghost]], [[Peanut]], [[Chovy]], [[Fly (Song Yong-jun)|Fly]], [[ShowMaker]], [[Kiin]], [[Aiming]], [[Rascal]], [[deokdam]], [[Canyon]], [[Cuzz]] and [[Viper (Park Do-hyeon)|Viper]]. * Reached 1500 LCK kills on September 1st, 2024. ** Was the 16th player reach 1500 kills, after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Deft]], [[Ruler]], [[Teddy]], [[Bdd]], [[Chovy]], [[Peanut]], [[Aiming]], [[ShowMaker]], [[Kiin]], and [[Viper (Park Do-hyeon)|Viper]]. * Reached 500 international kills during [[Worlds 2024 Main Event|Worlds 2024]] on October 19th, 2024 in Quarterfinals, becoming the 7th player to achieve this milestone after [[Faker]], [[Perkz]], [[xiaohu]], [[Caps]], [[Maple (Huang Yi-Tang) | Maple]], and [[GALA]]. * Reached 100 international wins during [[2025 Mid-Season Invitational|MSI 2025]] on July 10th, 2025 against [[GEN]] in Upper Bracket Finals, becoming the 5/6th player (with Oner) to achieve this milestone after [[Faker]], [[xiaohu]], [[Caps]], and [[Keria]]. * He is the second player in Worlds history to go deathless in the Final, after [[Lwx]]. * In ninth grade, his father said that if he wanted to become a pro player, he would have to be Challenger in a month or he would have to give up League of Legends. He made it near the end of the month he was given.[https://www.theplayerstribune.com/posts/gumayusi-t1-league-of-legends-esports/ My Way by Gumayusi] ''theplayerstribune.com'' * Was featured in a video published by '''T1''' on ''Instagram'' where he dances with 2 other Korean influencers, which later on went viral on other social medias. The video was also used by LoL Esports to make memes.[https://www.instagram.com/p/C8tpuSRPQPY/ T1 LoL's Instagram Post] ''instagram.com''[https://x.com/lolesports/status/1806279136484176243 LoL Esports' X Post] ''x.com'' * Received a giant-sized croissant from French fans after defeating [[GenG]] and qualifying to the [[Worlds 2024|Worlds 2024 Grand Finals]]. His reaction afterwards got viral on Reddit.[https://www.reddit.com/r/LivestreamFail/comments/1gdfbgr/gumayusi_receives_normalsized_french_croissant/ Gumayusi receives normalsized french croissant] ''reddit.com'' * Sometimes dubbed as the "Unkillable Demon Prince".[https://x.com/lolesports/status/1851587218755686886/ LoL Esports' X Post] ''x.com'' {{PlayerStatsTrivia}} === Individual Awards === * Worlds Finals MVP x1 (2025) * LCK Bottom of the Year x3 (2023, 2024, 2025) * LCK 1st All-Pro Team x2 (Spring 2022, Spring 2023) * LCK 3rd All-Pro Team x2 (Spring 2024, LCK 2025) == Tournament Results == {{PlayerResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerShowmatchResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerResults1v1|show=overviewpage}} == Media == {{PlayerMedia}} === Images === {{PlayerProfileGallery}} {{PlayerPageEnd}}
